synopsis: Town boards focused on capital planning and warrant preparation ahead of the October 17 Special Town Meeting. The Elementary School Building Committee narrowed design options for Neary Elementary School by eliminating Option 4 and directing consultants to develop Options 1, 3, and a $15 million scope baseline. The Select Board reopened and reclosed the special town meeting warrant, voting to support revised articles on two-family housing and an irrigation project while voting against a trail cleanup article. Meanwhile, the Municipal Technology Committee and Affordable Housing Trust coordinated on survey questions for the 2026 Town Satisfaction Survey ahead of its October rollout.

highlights.title: Neary School options narrowed to Options 1, 3, and $15M scope
highlights.why: The Elementary School Building Committee voted 3-1 to eliminate Option 4 and voted 4-0 to direct consultants to focus on Options 1, 3, and a $15 million baseline scope. Preliminary total cost models presented ranged from $24.4 million to $49.2 million.

highlights.title: Select Board votes on revised Special Town Meeting articles
highlights.why: The Select Board reopened the October 17 warrant to vote support for revised articles on two-family housing and a Community Preservation Act irrigation project. A motion to support a CPA trail project failed on a 1-4 vote.

highlights.title: Affordable Housing Trust explores investing $1M in cash reserves
highlights.why: Trustees discussed that roughly $1 million in trust funds currently earns near-zero interest and agreed to consult town finance officials regarding allowable higher-yield investment options.

highlights.title: Municipal Technology Committee prepares 2026 Satisfaction Survey
highlights.why: Members refined the town satisfaction survey to address past response drop-offs, incorporating input from the Affordable Housing Trust and Council on Aging ahead of an October 1 launch.

looking_ahead.what: Select Board meeting covering financial policies and Breakneck Hill debt reduction
Elementary School Building Committee meeting to finalize Town Meeting presentation
